facts.fact: Ahrefs charges $40 per month for each additional user on the plan with up to 2 additional users.
Ahrefs charges $60 per month for each additional user on the plan with up to 5 additional users.
Ahrefs charges $80 per month for each additional user on the plan with up to 10 additional users.
The Ahrefs pricing page states that paying annually saves up to 17%.
The lowest Ahrefs plan includes 750 tracked keywords and 6 months of historical data.
The middle Ahrefs plan includes 2,000 tracked keywords and 2 years of historical data.
The top-tier Ahrefs plan includes 5,000 tracked keywords and 5 years of historical data.
The lowest Ahrefs plan includes 100,000 crawl credits per month.
Ahrefs Brand Radar custom prompt package Basic costs $50 per month and includes 2,500 checks per month.
Ahrefs Brand Radar custom prompt package Growth costs $100 per month and includes 7,000 checks per month.
Ahrefs Brand Radar custom prompt package Scale costs $250 per month and includes 25,000 checks per month.
Overage for the Ahrefs Brand Radar Basic prompt package is billed at $0.020 per check monthly.
The Ahrefs Report Builder add-on costs $99 per month and includes 50 reports and 500 total widgets.
The Ahrefs Project Boost Pro add-on costs $20 per month per project.
The Ahrefs Project Boost Max add-on costs $200 per month per project.
The Ahrefs Traffic reports add-on costs $99 per month.
Ahrefs states it never runs discounts.
Ahrefs states that there are no contracts or setup fees and that subscriptions can be cancelled at any time.
facts.quote: There are no contracts or setup fees. You can switch your plan or cancel your Ahrefs subscription at any time.

facts.fact: Ahrefs states that the brand's Brand Radar tool draws on 558 million+ organic prompts from its database.
facts.quote: Research any brand across 558 million+ organic prompts from Ahrefs database

facts.fact: Ahrefs states that additional users are automatically charged on a pay-as-you-go basis if not prepaid.
facts.quote: If not prepaid for, additional users are automatically charged on a pay-as-you-go basis.

facts.fact: Ahrefs accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express and UnionPay, and offers wire transfers for Enterprise plans on request.
facts.quote: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express and UnionPay. For Enterprise plans, we also support wire transfers on request.

facts.fact: Ahrefs states that pay-as-you-go purchases such as report credits, export rows, crawl credits, and API units last for three billing months, including the current one.
facts.quote: PAYG purchases such as report credits, export rows, crawl credits, and API units, last for three billing months, including the current one.

facts.fact: Ahrefs states that pay-as-you-go credits purchased on 15 October with a usage reset date of the 20th expire on 20 December.
facts.quote: if the usage reset date is set to the 20th October and you’ve purchased PAYG credits on the 15th October, they will expire on the 20th December.

facts.fact: Ahrefs states that pre-paid limits are always used before pay-as-you-go credits.
facts.quote: Please note though that pre-paid limits are always used first.

facts.fact: Ahrefs states that it does not issue refunds in general.
facts.quote: Ahrefs does not issue refunds in general.

facts.fact: Ahrefs states that for monthly subscriptions a refund can be requested if the service has not been used, but the request may be declined if there is material activity in the account.
facts.quote: For monthly subscriptions, you can request for a refund if you haven't used the service, but we may decline your request if we see any material activity in your account.

facts.fact: Ahrefs states that users on an annual plan can choose to prepay additional pay-as-you-go credits and data at a discounted rate.
facts.quote: If you’re on an annual plan, you can choose to prepay at a discounted rate.

facts.fact: Ahrefs states that once additional pay-as-you-go credits and data are enabled, the account is automatically charged when consumption exceeds the plan's limits.
facts.quote: Once you enable additional pay-as-you-go credits and data, you’ll be automatically charged when consumption exceeds your plan’s limits.
